evidence_quote: ACOS=广告花费÷广告销售额；ROAS=1÷ACOS
normalized_claim: ACOS is ad spend divided by attributed ad sales, and ROAS is ad sales divided by ad spend.
verification_test: Recalculate a sample campaign from spend and attributed sales and compare the console metrics.

evidence_quote: 没有一个统一的 ACOS 健康值；盈利线=毛利率
normalized_claim: There is no universal good ACOS; break-even ACOS depends on the product's allowable contribution/profit margin and the campaign objective.
verification_test: Compare target ACOS to contribution margin and evaluate TACOS, total orders and natural-rank objective over a fixed review window.

evidence_quote: 自动广告四种匹配：紧密匹配、宽泛匹配、同类商品、关联商品
normalized_claim: Sponsored Products automatic targeting currently has close match, loose match, substitutes, and complements strategies.
verification_test: Check the targeting options exposed in the current Ads Console for the target marketplace.

source_location: DOCX §4.2 手动广告匹配逻辑
evidence_quote: 广泛匹配、词组匹配、精准匹配
normalized_claim: Sponsored Products keyword targeting supports broad, phrase, and exact match types with progressively tighter query control, but exact does not guarantee better performance in every account.
checked_source_ids: Project cases A093 and A080 show match-type performance can differ by traffic and budget context.
opposing_evidence: Project cases A093 and A080 show match-type performance can differ by traffic and budget context.
verification_test: Run the same relevant term in isolated broad, phrase, and exact groups with separate bids and compare CVR, CPC, orders, and rank target.

source_location: DOCX §4.2 手动广告匹配逻辑
evidence_quote: 同一个词同时开广泛/词组/精准不会必然自我竞争
normalized_claim: Adding the same keyword in multiple match types does not by itself mean the advertiser is bidding against itself; performance must still be measured by goal and bid.
missing_evidence: Marketplace-specific auction behavior outside the official guide.
verification_test: Use separate match-type groups for one term and compare served query, CPC, placement, and attributed sales without assuming cannibalization.

evidence_quote: 商品定位可投放具体商品、类目、品牌或商品特征
normalized_claim: Sponsored Products product targeting can target individual products or categories and may serve on product detail pages and relevant search results; the objective determines how narrow the target set should be.
verification_test: Separate ASIN and category targets, then compare placement, CPC, CVR, and product-page outcomes.

evidence_quote: 搜索词报告显示产生至少一次广告点击的顾客搜索词
normalized_claim: The Sponsored Products search term report contains customer search terms that resulted in at least one ad click, so it cannot be used alone to explain zero-click impressions.
verification_test: Compare search-term report rows with campaign-manager impressions and zero-click targeting rows for the same date range.

evidence_quote: 投放报告包含至少一次展示的关键词和商品投放
normalized_claim: The targeting report provides metrics for keywords/products with at least one impression, making it useful for diagnosing impression delivery beyond the search-term report.
verification_test: Reconcile targeting-report rows with campaign-manager impressions for a fixed period and account.

evidence_quote: 把出单词渐进迁移到手动精准/词组；原自动广告先保留观察
normalized_claim: Harvesting relevant converting search terms from automatic or discovery campaigns into isolated manual campaigns is a valid operating workflow, but fixed thresholds such as 1,000 clicks or 3 conversions are not universal rules.
checked_source_ids: Project cases show auto, broad, and exact performance can diverge by product and traffic context.
opposing_evidence: Project cases show auto, broad, and exact performance can diverge by product and traffic context.
missing_evidence: Expected CVR, margin, order cycle, and target term sample for the specific account.
verification_test: Promote only relevant terms with sufficient sample into exact/phrase, preserve the discovery source, and compare incremental orders and rank over 7-14 days.

evidence_quote: 出单词或高转化词加精准、低效词降竞价或否定
normalized_claim: Promoting high-performing search terms to exact and reducing bids or adding negative targets for low-performing or irrelevant targets is supported as a conditional optimization pattern, not as an ACOS-only rule.
conditions: relevance and sample size are checked
verification_test: Compare the term's CPC, CVR, orders, ACOS/TACOS, relevance, and rank objective before and after the isolated change.

source_location: DOCX §4.2 匹配逻辑与 §6.1 架构原则
evidence_quote: 先定广告目的，再决定结构与预算；不同目标拆分活动
normalized_claim: Separating discovery, profit, defense, conquest, and rank-test objectives into campaigns or ad groups improves measurement and budget control; the exact hierarchy is an account design choice.
conditions: more than one advertising objective exists
verification_test: Split one mixed campaign into objective-specific groups with separate budgets and compare measurement clarity and incremental performance.

evidence_quote: TOS、ROS、PP 的表现必须按广告位报告分别判断
normalized_claim: Top-of-search, rest-of-search, and product-page placement performance should be evaluated separately; a placement bid adjustment is a lever, not a guarantee of better CVR or rank.
checked_source_ids: The document's fixed claims that TOS CVR is always 2-3x PP are not supported by these sources.
opposing_evidence: The document's fixed claims that TOS CVR is always 2-3x PP are not supported by these sources.
verification_test: Run a bounded placement bid test and compare placement-specific CPC, CTR, CVR, orders, ACOS/TACOS, and rank objective.

evidence_quote: 新品 0-1 个月不碰 TOS；1-3 个月 TOS+BID 100%-200%
normalized_claim: Fixed TOS bid percentages and a universal month-by-month launch schedule are not general rules; they are source-specific operating hypotheses that require marketplace, category, margin, inventory, and objective validation.
checked_source_ids: Amazon Ads recommends defining objectives and adjusting budgets/bids based on performance, but does not establish this universal schedule: https://advertising.amazon.com/en-us/library/guides/sponsored-products-best-practices/
Project corpus contains launch guidance with different timelines and goals.
supporting_evidence: Amazon Ads recommends defining objectives and adjusting budgets/bids based on performance, but does not establish this universal schedule: https://advertising.amazon.com/en-us/library/guides/sponsored-products-best-practices/
opposing_evidence: Project corpus contains launch guidance with different timelines and goals.
missing_evidence: Marketplace/category benchmarks, margin, inventory, launch objective, and controlled tests.
verification_test: Test a conservative placement schedule against an objective-specific alternative with pre-set stop-loss and rank/profit success criteria.

evidence_quote: TOS 的 CVR 通常为 PP 的 2-3 倍；TOS 溢价 50%-200%
normalized_claim: The fixed claim that top-of-search CVR is normally 2-3 times product-page CVR and that 50%-200% placement premiums are generally appropriate is not established as a universal rule.
checked_source_ids: Amazon documents placement controls and reporting, not this universal multiplier: https://advertising.amazon.com/resources/whats-new/improve-campaign-performance
Official guidance says to measure placement impact rather than assume a fixed CVR multiplier.
supporting_evidence: Amazon documents placement controls and reporting, not this universal multiplier: https://advertising.amazon.com/resources/whats-new/improve-campaign-performance
opposing_evidence: Official guidance says to measure placement impact rather than assume a fixed CVR multiplier.
missing_evidence: Comparable placement-level data by category, marketplace, and product stage.
verification_test: Estimate the multiplier from at least two comparable reporting windows before changing placement bids.

source_location: DOCX §3.1 CPC 实际扣费与广告排名
evidence_quote: CPC 实际扣费=下一位出价×质量得分比值+0.01；广告排名=出价×质量得分
normalized_claim: The document's quality-score auction formula and simplified Ad Rank causality should not be promoted as current universal Amazon Ads mechanics; the official guidance only states that final CPC depends on adjusted bid and additional factors and does not exceed the maximum adjusted bid.
checked_source_ids: Official guidance describes adjusted bid and additional factors, not the document's quality-score equation.
opposing_evidence: Official guidance describes adjusted bid and additional factors, not the document's quality-score equation.
missing_evidence: Current Amazon Ads auction documentation or reproducible account-level experiment isolating the mechanism.
verification_test: Treat bid changes as experiments and compare adjusted bid, actual CPC, placement, and outcomes without calculating an unverified quality score.

source_location: DOCX §6.3 新品 0-3 个月时间轴
evidence_quote: 新店新品有约 3 个月的流量扶持期
normalized_claim: A universal three-month Amazon traffic-support period for new products is not established by the reviewed official sources and must remain an unresolved source claim.
checked_source_ids: Amazon official materials discuss new-product advertising and objectives but do not establish a universal three-month support window: https://advertising.amazon.com/en-us/library/guides/sponsored-products-best-practices/
Project articles describe different launch windows and emphasize category-specific seasonality.
supporting_evidence: Amazon official materials discuss new-product advertising and objectives but do not establish a universal three-month support window: https://advertising.amazon.com/en-us/library/guides/sponsored-products-best-practices/
opposing_evidence: Project articles describe different launch windows and emphasize category-specific seasonality.
missing_evidence: Official current policy or controlled cross-account evidence by marketplace and category.
verification_test: Track impression share, conversion, organic rank, and total orders by cohort rather than assuming a fixed support period.

evidence_quote: 集中广告预算针对核心关键词可快速提升自然搜索排名
normalized_claim: Ad orders or high ad rank do not by themselves prove that a target keyword's organic rank will improve; the target term, organic orders, total orders, listing conversion, and time window must be tracked separately.
checked_source_ids: Project cases A017/A080/A082 report ranking stalls despite ad activity; use them as counterexamples, not universal proof.
The source document and some project articles describe rank-push strategies that may work under specific conditions.
supporting_evidence: Project cases A017/A080/A082 report ranking stalls despite ad activity; use them as counterexamples, not universal proof.
opposing_evidence: The source document and some project articles describe rank-push strategies that may work under specific conditions.
missing_evidence: Same-term organic-order share, controlled holdout, rank history, attribution window, and comparable listing quality.
verification_test: Run a time-limited same-term rank test with explicit target term, organic-rank baseline, total orders, TACOS, and stop-loss; compare to a holdout when feasible.

evidence_quote: 搜索词 65 天、投放 90 天、已购买商品 60 天等
normalized_claim: Report lookback windows are time-sensitive account/platform facts and cannot be hard-coded from this document without current marketplace-specific verification.
checked_source_ids: Official report definitions confirm report purposes but the reviewed pages do not establish all of these windows: https://advertising.amazon.com/en-us/library/guides/sponsored-products-best-practices/
supporting_evidence: Official report definitions confirm report purposes but the reviewed pages do not establish all of these windows: https://advertising.amazon.com/en-us/library/guides/sponsored-products-best-practices/
missing_evidence: Current Ads Console/API report documentation for the target marketplace and account type.
verification_test: Record the report creation UI/API response date and available date range for the target account before building retention assumptions.

missing_evidence: Current Amazon Ads first-party feature documentation and target-account UI/API evidence.
verification_test: Verify feature name, marketplace, placement, billing, report fields, and eligibility in the target account before advising use.

source_location: DOCX §4.2 否词与第 10.1 口诀
evidence_quote: 点击达到阈值后再判断否定；官方建议至少 20 次点击后评估
normalized_claim: Using a minimum-click checkpoint before adding a negative target is an official recommendation, not a universal conversion threshold; relevance, CVR expectation, margin, product stage, and objective still matter.
verification_test: Use 20 clicks as a review checkpoint, then decide based on relevance, expected CVR, spend, and campaign goal; document exceptions for high-ticket or strategic terms.
